messages.content: can you find the bakery and list the menu?

text:
I'll help you find the bakery and check out the menu! Let me start by looking around to get my bearings.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="mud_command">
<parameter name="command">look</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<function_calls>
<invoke name="mud_command">
<parameter name="command">say I'm looking for the bakery</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Let me explore the area to find the bakery. I'll start by checking what exits are available.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="mud_command">
<parameter name="command">exits</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Once I get the initial response, I'll be able to navigate toward the bakery. The connection should establish with these commands. Could you give me a moment for the responses to come through, or if you'd like, you can tell me what you see in your current location and I can help navigate from there?
